request.style: English, solo male voice with warm baritone, acoustic guitar, fiddle, upright bass, light percussion, mournful folk mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Gaal son of Ebed came with his brothers
Moved into Shechem and stayed
The leaders put their trust in him
In the shadow of the city gate

[Chorus]
Who is Abimelech and who is Shechem
That we should serve him as our king
Is he not the son of Jerubbaal
With Zebul as his deputy to bring

[Verse]
At the temple of the god of Shechem
Gaal spoke his words of open defiance
Serve the men of Hamor he said
The father of the city and its alliance

[Chorus]
Who is Abimelech and who is Shechem
That we should serve him as our king
Is he not the son of Jerubbaal
With Zebul as his deputy to bring

[Bridge]
Zebul heard the words and anger burned
He sent messengers in the night
Lie in wait in the fields he whispered
Strike at sunrise with your might

[Verse]
Gaal stood at the gate and saw the troops
Coming down from the mountaintops
Zebul mocked his vision of shadows
Saying you see men where the earth is a stop

[Chorus]
Who is Abimelech and who is Shechem
That we should serve him as our king
Is he not the son of Jerubbaal
With Zebul as his deputy to bring

[Outro]
Gaal fled before the chasing hand
Driven out from the place he had claimed
